name: XCC_CB_OVERRIDE_RULES
description: This table contains the override rules for a control budget. It stores both insufficient funds overrides and closed period overrides.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the override rule.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget for which this override rule is applicable.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Unique name of the override rule.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the override rule.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of override rule. Valid values are INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS for insufficient funds overrides and CLOSED_PERIOD for closed period overrides.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that an insufficent funds override can override by. This amount is in the budget currency. It is required for insufficient funds overrides. No amount can be supplied for closed period overrides.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this override rule is enabled.

columns.name: ALL_TRANSACTION_TYPES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this override rule applies for all transaction types.

columns.name: ALL_JOURNAL_SOURCES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this override rule applies for all General Ledger journal sources. The value is Y if this override rule does not apply to General Ledger transactions or if it applies to all transaction types.

columns.name: ALL_JOURNAL_CATEGORIES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this override rule applies for all General Ledger journal categories. The value is Y if this override rule does not apply to General Ledger transactions or if it applies to all transaction types.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
